title: RC-23 LOG_LEVEL in .env is never applied: the logger is created when config.ts imports it, one line before config.ts calls dotenv.config(), and bot.ts imports config first

evidence.note: import dotenv; import { logger } from './utils/logger'; then dotenv.config(): the logger module runs before .env is loaded
pino({ level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info' }) evaluated once at import
bot.ts imports ethers, then './config' as its first project module, so config.ts is the first importer of the logger on the bot path

evidence.ref: node -e "pino({level:'verbose'})" with the repo pino 10.3.1 (Node 22.16.0, scratch folder)
evidence.note: an unknown level throws 'default level:verbose must be included in custom levels' at construction; 'DEBUG' is accepted as debug

sibling_sites_checked: dotenv.config() call sites at the base SHA: src/config.ts:4 and src/utils/notifier.ts:6 in src, and every script under scripts/ (git grep "dotenv"). A LOG_LEVEL set in the shell is honoured (the logger reads process.env at import). Scripts that call dotenv.config() before importing a src module would honour .env; scripts are the SCRIPTS slice. 14 debug-level log sites exist in src (git grep -c ".debug("), including { err } logs of failed RPC calls at bot.ts:996, :1011, :1330 and exitEngine.ts:342 (every 5 s per position on a failing price query).
severity_rationale: S3, equal to the research suggestion: misleading configuration (the documented key in .env.example:91 does nothing), no capital effect. Fixing it is a behaviour change because debug output includes whole ethers error objects, which carry the RPC URL (and so the provider API key, AUD-TX-014) on HTTP errors, at a volume of one line per position every 5 s.
recommendation: Load .env before the logger is first imported (or make the logger read the level lazily), after redaction is in place for err objects. Card OD-10. Phase 29 unless the card says otherwise.

triage.note: Reproduced as production behavior (plan 23-13): fixtures/logLevelOrder.ts runs as a railed child with VITEST unset (so src/config.ts:5 calls dotenv.config(); the review concern that a VITEST child proves nothing is closed), from a throwaway folder whose inert .env sets LOG_LEVEL=debug; it deletes the sentinel LOG_LEVEL first, imports src/config (bot.ts's first project module), then src/utils/logger. The child reports vitest false and LOG_LEVEL 'debug' loaded from the file, and the logger's level 'info' (claim log-level-from-env-file-not-applied, observed {loggerLevel info}, correct {loggerLevel debug}): logger.ts reads LOG_LEVEL during its import, which config.ts runs before dotenv.config(). src/main.ts keeps that order on purpose (it reads .env into a private object, src/main.ts:39-42), so a real start behaves the same. Phase 29 reading (card OD-10): loading .env before the logger's first import, or a lazy level, flips the claim to looks fixed (fix-shaped mutation of src/utils/logger.ts, restored byte for byte); per the finding, land it after redaction, because debug output carries ethers error objects with RPC URLs (AUD-TX-014).
